snippet.title: Gray Zone Warfare: Night Ops Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Play Night Ops now. We’re celebrating an incredible milestone: Gray Zone Warfare has ranked in Steam's Top 20 New Steam Paid Games for 2024, with over 1 million base game units sold and 1.5 million total units sold since the Early Access launch! To thank you, we’re releasing a brand new Night Ops gameplay trailer.

Since the Night Ops release, we’ve rolled out multiple hotfixes and patches to improve gameplay—check out all the details on Gray Zone Warfare's Steam page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2479810/Gray_Zone_Warfare/

If you love Gray Zone Warfare, help us spread the word—share this video and leave a positive review on Steam!

#EveryMoveMatters
